proof_requests: Video of the lens mounted on a Nikon body showing autofocus and aperture operation
Photo of the lens against a bright light source showing the full optical path for fungus/haze/scratch
Close-up photo of the rear mount and electronic contacts
Clarification on whether one or two lenses are included in the sale, and what accessories (hood, caps) come with it
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Nikon AF-S NIKKOR 50mm 1.8G lens, but key seller claims (shutter count, battery/charger) do not match a lens and appear to be boilerplate, so functional and cosmetic claims must be treated as unverified and priced at worst case pending proof.
